title: The resume guard refuses a subagent's message to a finished reviewer
why: A subagent can message a reviewer whose worktree is gone, and the work sent is lost. The guard for the orchestrator case (resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree, #1917) does not see a subagent's sends.
